about.name: Christie Kanska
about.bioHead: A life in music, from Yerevan to Carnegie Hall
about.bioP1: Christie Kanska’s work as vocalist, pianist, composer and educator is carried by honesty and artistic mastery — and a love for people, nature and life that runs through her original music and poetic lyrics.
about.bioP2: Born in Yerevan, Armenia, she began the piano at seven, taught voice in Thessaloniki and graduated from Berklee College of Music on scholarship. She has sung at Carnegie Hall, toured her album “Le Rêve – The Dream” across India, and is a Recording Academy member, GRAMMY U Mentor, Steinway & Sons educator and RCM-certified teacher.
about.bioP3: She is the founder of ZCK Music Academy & Recording Studios and the creator of Song Bird.

timeline.text: Born in Yerevan, Armenia. Begins piano at seven and sings with the National Chorus.
Vocal faculty at the New Odeon of Thessaloniki and the Filippos Nakas Odeon Conservatory.
Lead singer of her jazz band at festivals in Thessaloniki, European Capital of Culture.
Bachelor of Music in Professional Music, Berklee College of Music, on scholarship.
Founds ZCK Music Academy & Recording Studios in New York.
Releases “Le Rêve – The Dream” and tours across India.
Recording Academy member, Steinway & Sons educator, writes “Stay Home”.
Selected as Recording Academy GRAMMY U Mentor.
